notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

# Ported from PluckArtifact.jl/src/table1/sequence_models/dice/pcfg.jl of
# the artifact of Bowers et al., "Stochastic Lazy Knowledge Compilation for
# Inference in Discrete Probabilistic Programs" (PLDI 2025), Zenodo
# 10.5281/zenodo.15051140 (CC-BY-4.0): the Dice.jl baseline of the paper's
# Table 1, row PCFG. Mechanical port: Dice.List, Dice.Nil and Dice.Cons ->
# Alea's List, Nil and Cons, @dice_ite -> @alea_ite, the add_benchmark!
# harness dropped, `pr(E)` -> E, the query moved to QUERY and model().
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr


@inductive Nonterminal SS() XX() YY()
@inductive Terminal aa() bb() cc()

function prob_list_append(l1::List{Terminal}, l2::List{Terminal}, fuel::Int)
    fuel == 0 && return Nil(Terminal)
    match(l1, [:Nil => () -> l2, :Cons => (hd, tl) -> Cons(Terminal, hd, prob_list_append(tl, l2, fuel-1))])
end


function generate_from_grammar(sym::Union{Dist{Nonterminal}, Nonterminal}, fuel::Int, append_fuel::Int)
    fuel == 0 && return Nil(Terminal)

    match(sym, [:XX => () -> (@alea_ite if flip(0.5); Cons(Terminal, bb(), prob_list_append(generate_from_grammar(XX(), fuel-1, append_fuel), generate_from_grammar(XX(), fuel-1, append_fuel), append_fuel)); else; Cons(Terminal, aa(), Nil(Terminal)); end),
                :YY => () -> (@alea_ite if flip(0.5); Cons(Terminal, cc(), generate_from_grammar(XX(), fuel-1, append_fuel)); else; (@alea_ite if flip(0.5); Cons(Terminal, cc(), generate_from_grammar(SS(), fuel-1, append_fuel)); else; Cons(Terminal, cc(), Nil(Terminal)); end); end),
                :SS => () -> (@alea_ite if flip(0.5); prob_list_append(generate_from_grammar(XX(), fuel-1, append_fuel), generate_from_grammar(YY(), fuel-1, append_fuel), append_fuel); else; prob_list_append(generate_from_grammar(YY(), fuel-1, append_fuel), generate_from_grammar(XX(), fuel-1, append_fuel), append_fuel); end)])

end

function pcfg_equals(l1::List{Terminal}, l2::List{Terminal}, fuel::Int)
    fuel == 0 && return false
    match(l1, [:Nil => () -> match(l2, [:Nil => () -> true, :Cons => (hd, tl) -> false]), :Cons => (hd1, tl1) -> match(l2, [:Nil => () -> false, :Cons => (hd2, tl2) -> (@alea_ite if prob_equals(hd1, hd2); pcfg_equals(tl1, tl2, fuel-1); else; false; end)])])
end

SYMBOL_TO_TERM = Dict(:a => aa(), :b => bb(), :c => cc())
function observation_list_from_symbols(symbols)
    if symbols == []
        return Nil(Terminal)
    else
        return Cons(Terminal, SYMBOL_TO_TERM[symbols[1]], observation_list_from_symbols(symbols[2:end]))
    end
end

function generate_observation_list(julia_list)
    obs_list = Nil(Terminal)
    sym_to_term = Dict(:aa => aa(), :bb => bb(), :cc => cc())
    for symbol in reverse(julia_list)
        obs_list = Cons(Terminal, sym_to_term[symbol], obs_list)
    end
    return obs_list
end


function pcfg_example(example, fuel, append_fuel)
    start = SS()
    return pcfg_equals(generate_from_grammar(start, fuel, append_fuel), generate_observation_list(example), append_fuel)
end

len_23_fuel_11_example = [:cc, :bb, :bb, :bb, :aa, :bb, :bb, :aa, :bb, :aa, :bb, :bb, :aa, :bb, :aa, :aa, :aa, :aa, :aa, :bb, :aa, :aa, :aa]

model() = pcfg_example(len_23_fuel_11_example, 12, 24)

# Ported from PluckArtifact.jl/src/table1/sequence_models/dice/hmm.jl of
# the artifact of Bowers et al., "Stochastic Lazy Knowledge Compilation for
# Inference in Discrete Probabilistic Programs" (PLDI 2025), Zenodo
# 10.5281/zenodo.15051140 (CC-BY-4.0): the Dice.jl baseline of the paper's
# Table 1, row HMM. Mechanical port: Dice.List, Dice.Nil and Dice.Cons ->
# Alea's List, Nil and Cons, @dice_ite -> @alea_ite, the add_benchmark!
# harness dropped, `pr(E)` -> E, the query moved to QUERY and model().
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr


function dice_hmm_example(N)

    function make_bool_list(n)
        n == 0 && return Nil(AnyBool)
        Cons(AnyBool, true, make_bool_list(n-1))
    end

    function hmm(z0, num_steps)

        if num_steps == 0
            return Nil(AnyBool)
        end

        z1 = @alea_ite if z0 
            flip(0.7)
        else
            flip(0.1)
        end

        x1 = @alea_ite if z1 
            flip(0.3)
        else
            flip(0.6)
        end

        return Cons(AnyBool, x1, hmm(z1, num_steps - 1))
    end
        
    function bool_lists_equal(l1::List{AnyBool}, l2::List{AnyBool})
        match(l1, [:Nil => () -> match(l2, [:Nil => () -> true, :Cons => (hd, tl) -> false]), :Cons => (x, xs) -> match(l2, [:Cons => (y, ys) -> (@alea_ite if (prob_equals(x, y)); bool_lists_equal(xs, ys); else; false; end), :Nil => () -> false])])
    end 

    return bool_lists_equal(hmm(false, N), make_bool_list(N))
end

model() = dice_hmm_example(50)

function sorted_defs()

  @define "nats_equal" """
  (Y (λ rec m n -> (case m of 
    O => (case n of O => true | S npred => false)
    S mpred => (case n of O => false | S npred => (rec mpred npred)))
  ))
  """

  @define "nat_lists_equal" """
  (Y (λ rec xs ys -> (case xs of 
    Nil => (case ys of Nil => true | Cons yhd ytl => false)
    Cons xhd xtl => (case ys of Nil => false | Cons yhd ytl => (and (nats_equal xhd yhd) (rec xtl ytl))))))
  """

  @define "random_num_larger_than" """
  (λmin -> (+ randnat min))
  """

  @define "random_num_larger_than_fuel" """
  (Y (λ rec fuel min -> 
    (case fuel of
    S fuel =>
      (if (flip 0.5) 
        min 
        (S (rec fuel min))
      )
    )
  ))
  """

  @define "generate_sorted_list" """
  (Y (λ rec min -> (if (flip 0.5) (Nil) (let (m (random_num_larger_than min)) (Cons m (rec m))))))
  """

  @define "generate_sorted_list_fuel" """
  (Y (λ rec fuel fuel_num min ->
    (case fuel of
    S fuel =>
        (if (flip 0.5) (Nil) (let (m (random_num_larger_than_fuel fuel_num min)) (Cons m (rec fuel fuel_num m))))
    )
  ))
  """

end

function make_long_sorted_list(n, m = 0)
    if n == 0
        return "(Nil)"
    else
        return "(Cons $(m) $(make_long_sorted_list(n-1, m+1)))"
    end
end

l = [0, 3, 7, 12, 13, 15, 16, 20, 21, 25][1:8]
sorted_list_query() = generate_sorted_list_test(l)
test_to_perform_fuel(fuel, fuel_num) = generate_sorted_list_test_fuel(l, fuel, fuel_num)


function run_sorted_list_bdd(; kwargs...)

    @bbtime bdd_forward(test_to_perform; state=$BDDEvalState(; $kwargs...))

function hmm_defs()

  @define "hmm" """
  (Y (λ rec z0 -> 
    (let (z1 (flip (if z0 0.7 0.1)))   
      (Cons (flip (if z1 0.3 0.6)) (rec z1)))))
  """

  @define "prefix_equals?" """
  (Y (λ rec xs ys -> 
    (case ys of Nil => true | 
                Cons yhd ytl => (case xs of Nil => false | 
                                            Cons xhd xtl => (and (constructors_equal xhd yhd) (rec xtl ytl))))))
  """

  @define "prefix_equals_smc?" """
  (Y (λ rec xs ys -> 
    (case ys of Nil => (FinallyTrue) | 
        Cons yhd ytl => (case xs of Nil => (FinallyFalse) | 
              Cons xhd xtl => (if (constructors_equal xhd yhd) (Suspend (rec xtl ytl)) (FinallyFalse))))))
  """

  @define "generate_observations" "(Y (λ rec n -> (case n of O => (Nil) | S => (λ npred -> (Cons (True) (rec npred))))))"

  @define "hmm_example" "(λ n -> (prefix_equals? (hmm (False)) (generate_observations n)))"
  @define "hmm_example_smc" "(λ n -> (prefix_equals_smc? (hmm (False)) (generate_observations n)))"
end

add_benchmark!("hmm", "pluck_default", PluckBenchmark("(hmm_example 50)"; pre=hmm_defs))

# Ported from PluckArtifact.jl/src/table1/sequence_models/dice/sorted_list.jl of
# the artifact of Bowers et al., "Stochastic Lazy Knowledge Compilation for
# Inference in Discrete Probabilistic Programs" (PLDI 2025), Zenodo
# 10.5281/zenodo.15051140 (CC-BY-4.0): the Dice.jl baseline of the paper's
# Table 1, row Sorted List. Mechanical port: Dice.List, Dice.Nil and Dice.Cons ->
# Alea's List, Nil and Cons, @dice_ite -> @alea_ite, the add_benchmark!
# harness dropped, `pr(E)` -> E, the query moved to QUERY and model().
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr



function gen_sorted_nat(min_val, fuel)
    fuel == 0 && return min_val
    @alea_ite if flip(0.5)
        min_val
    else
        Nat.S(gen_sorted_nat(min_val, fuel-1))
    end
end

function gen_sorted_list(max_size, min_val, fuel)
    max_size == 0 && return Nil(Nat.t)
    @alea_ite if flip(0.5)
        Nil(Nat.t)
    else
        let hd = gen_sorted_nat(min_val, fuel)
            Cons(Nat.t, hd, gen_sorted_list(max_size-1, hd, fuel))
        end
    end
end

function nats_equal(n1::Nat.t, n2::Nat.t)
    match(n1, [
        :Z => () -> match(n2, [:Z => () -> true, :S => (n2pred) -> false]),
        :S => (n1pred) -> match(n2, [:S => (n2pred) -> nats_equal(n1pred, n2pred), :Z => () -> false]),
    ])
end

function lists_equal(l1::List{Nat.t}, l2::List{Nat.t})
    match(l1, [
        :Nil => () -> match(l2, [:Nil => () -> true, :Cons => (hd, tl) -> false]),
        :Cons => (x, xs) -> match(l2, [:Cons => (y, ys) -> (@alea_ite if (nats_equal(x, y)); lists_equal(xs, ys); else; false; end), :Nil => () -> false]),
    ])
end


make_nat(n) = if n == 0; Nat.Z(); else Nat.S(make_nat(n-1)); end

make_list(l) = if isempty(l); Nil(Nat.t); else Cons(Nat.t, make_nat(l[1]), make_list(l[2:end])); end

l = [0, 3, 7, 12, 13, 15, 16, 20]
test_list = make_list(l);

model() = lists_equal(gen_sorted_list(9, Nat.Z(), 6), make_list(l))

# S -> XX YY | YY XX
# XX -> aa | bb XX XX 
# YY -> cc | cc XX | cc S

function pcfg_defs()

    Pluck.define_type!(:pcfg_grammar_symbol, Dict(:SS => Symbol[], :XX => Symbol[], :YY => Symbol[], :a => Symbol[], :b => Symbol[], :c => Symbol[]))

    @define "generate_pcfg_grammar" """
    (Y (λ generate symbol -> 
      (case symbol of 
        SS => (let (xgen (generate ( XX )) ygen (generate (YY)) order (flip 0.5))
          (if order (append xgen ygen) (append ygen xgen)))
        XX => (if (flip 0.5) (Cons (a) (Nil)) (Cons (b) (append (generate (XX)) (generate (XX)))))
        YY => (Cons (c) (if (flip 0.5) (Nil) (generate (if (flip 0.5) (XX) (SS)))))
      )
    ))
    """

    @define "generate_pcfg_grammar_fuel" """
    (Y (λ generate fuel symbol -> 
      (case fuel of
        S fuel => 
          (case symbol of 
            SS => (let (xgen (generate fuel ( XX )) ygen (generate fuel (YY)) order (flip 0.5))
                (if order (append xgen ygen) (append ygen xgen)))
            XX => (if (flip 0.5) (Cons (a) (Nil)) (Cons (b) (append (generate fuel (XX)) (generate fuel (XX)))))
            YY => (Cons (c) (if (flip 0.5) (Nil) (generate fuel (if (flip 0.5) (XX) (SS)))))
          )
      )
    ))
    """

    @define "symbol_equals" """
    (λ symbol1 symbol2 ->
      (case symbol1 of
        a => (case symbol2 of
          a => true
          b => false
          c => false)
        b => (case symbol2 of
          a => false
          b => true
          c => false)
        c => (case symbol2 of
          a => false
          b => false
          c => true)
      )
    )
    """

    @define "list_symbols_equal" """
    (Y (λ rec list1 list2 ->
      (case list1 of
        Nil => (case list2 of
          Nil => true
          Cons _ _ => false)
        Cons hd1 tl1 => (case list2 of
          Nil => false
          Cons hd2 tl2 => (and (symbol_equals hd1 hd2) (rec tl1 tl2)))
      )
    ))
    """
end

function make_string_from_julia_list(l)
    # l is a list of symbols :a, :b, :c
    # We want to return a string that looks like (Cons (a) (Cons (b) (Cons (c) (Nil))))
    result = ""
    for symbol in l
        result *= "(Cons ($symbol) "
    end
    result *= "(Nil)" * repeat(")", length(l))
    return result
end

# test_example_string = [:c, :c, :b, :a, :b, :b, :a, :b, :a, :a, :b, :b, :a, :a, :a, :a, :a]
test_example_string = [:c, :b, :b, :b, :a, :b, :b, :a, :b, :a, :b, :b, :a, :b, :a, :a, :a, :a, :a, :b, :a, :a, :a]
test_example_string_program = make_string_from_julia_list(test_example_string)


pcfg_query() = "(list_symbols_equal (generate_pcfg_grammar (SS)) $test_example_string_program)"


pcfg_example_enum() = lazy_enumerate("(list_symbols_equal (generate_pcfg_grammar (SS)) $test_example_string_program)"; disable_cache = true)

function make_long_observation_string(n)
    result_prefix = ""
    result_suffix = ""
    # something of the form abababababab...bcbcbcbcbc with a c in the middle
    for i = 1:n
        result_prefix *= "(Cons (a) (Cons (b) "
        result_suffix *= "(Cons (b) (Cons (c) "
    end
    result_suffix *= "(Nil)" * repeat(")", 4n + 1)
    return result_prefix * "(Cons (c) " * result_suffix
end


pcfg_example_long(n) = "(list_symbols_equal (generate_dice_grammar (Start)) $(make_long_observation_string(n)))"
pcfg_example_long_fuel(n, fuel) = "(list_symbols_equal (generate_dice_grammar_fuel $fuel (Start)) $(make_long_observation_string(n)))"

# Ported from PluckArtifact.jl/src/table1/sequence_models/dice/string_editing.jl of
# the artifact of Bowers et al., "Stochastic Lazy Knowledge Compilation for
# Inference in Discrete Probabilistic Programs" (PLDI 2025), Zenodo
# 10.5281/zenodo.15051140 (CC-BY-4.0): the Dice.jl baseline of the paper's
# Table 1, row String Editing. Mechanical port: Dice.List, Dice.Nil and Dice.Cons ->
# Alea's List, Nil and Cons, @dice_ite -> @alea_ite, the add_benchmark!
# harness dropped, `pr(E)` -> E, the query moved to QUERY and model().
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

@inductive PerturbChar a_() b_() c_() d_() e_()

function random_char()
    @alea_ite if flip(0.2)
        a_()
    elseif flip(0.25)
        b_()
    elseif flip(0.33333)
        c_()
    elseif flip(0.5)
        d_()
    else
        e_()
    end
end

function random_string(p, max_length)
    if max_length == 0
        return Nil(PerturbChar)
    else 
        @alea_ite if flip(p)
            Cons(PerturbChar, random_char(), random_string(p, max_length-1))
        else
            Nil(PerturbChar)
        end
    end
end

function list_append(l1, l2)
    match(l1, [:Nil => () -> l2, :Cons => (hd, tl) -> Cons(PerturbChar, hd, list_append(tl, l2))])
end

function perturb(s, fuel, max_insert_length)

  fuel == 0 && return s

  insertion = random_string(0.01, max_insert_length)

  match(s, [:Nil => () -> insertion, 
            :Cons => (hd, tl) -> let perturbed_tail = perturb(tl, fuel-1, max_insert_length); (@alea_ite if flip(0.99); list_append(insertion, Cons(PerturbChar, hd, perturbed_tail)); else; perturbed_tail; end); end])

end


function list_symbols_equal(l1::List{PerturbChar}, l2::List{PerturbChar}, fuel::Int)
    fuel == 0 && return false
    match(l1, [:Nil => () -> match(l2, [:Nil => () -> true, :Cons => (hd, tl) -> false]), :Cons => (hd1, tl1) -> match(l2, [:Nil => () -> false, :Cons => (hd2, tl2) -> (@alea_ite if prob_equals(hd1, hd2); list_symbols_equal(tl1, tl2, fuel-1); else; false; end)])])
end

function make_string_for_perturb(s)
    if s == ""
        return Nil(PerturbChar)
    else
        chars = Dict(["a" => a_(), "b" => b_(), "c" => c_(), "d" => d_(), "e" => e_()])
        return Cons(PerturbChar, chars[s[1:1]], make_string_for_perturb(s[2:end]))
    end
end

long_string_1 = "edccdadbedadbbacddbecaedddaabdccbadadeaecbadcacedbdeeaadadcbeadedbdaebccdaeaaadabecdcadebaddbbdbceea"
long_string_2 = "edddecbcadccbeecedbabbcbbcaeebeebaabddbcbcaccdaddceeddedddbabdabceceabaccbbbcbcacceceaecacdddbbdaedb"

function perturb_example(n, m)
    before_string = make_string_for_perturb(long_string_1[1:n])
    after_string =  make_string_for_perturb(long_string_2[1:m])
    return list_symbols_equal(perturb(before_string, n+1, m+1), after_string, max(n+1, m+1))
end

model() = perturb_example(4, 5)
